subject: GCP listing activation kickoff — seller activation litmus & procurement next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: GCP listing activation kickoff — seller activation litmus & procurement next steps

Hi Sarah —

Great to connect on the GCP Marketplace listing. Before we lock a launch date, I want to run a short kickoff to align on procurement blockers and an activation litmus (simple checklist that surfaces billing/SKU/contract items early). I attached a one-sheet (seller_activation_litmus.xlsx) that lists the typical gating items we see.

High-level asks from our side so we can scope the procurement flow: 
- Confirm procurement contact (name + email + phone) who will own PO and SOW in your org.
- Do you need Redwood to accept a specific EULA/PO flow or are standard GCP marketplace terms acceptable?
- Any special billing requirements (reseller vs direct billing, invoicing cadence, tax exempt details)?
- Security/compliance evidence: SOC 2 attestation or equivalent — can you share a current report or link?

Proposed short sync (30m) to triage items and assign owners: 
- Tue 6/22 10:00–10:30am ET
- Tue 6/22 3:00–3:30pm ET
Please let me know which works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Next steps from Redwood after sync: we’ll share a SKU mapping template, a draft SOW for DocuSign, and a short mutual action plan with deadlines so your procurement can route internally.

Thanks — excited to get CloudWave on the marketplace.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
Attachments: seller_activation_litmus.xlsx
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@cloudwave.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudWave Procurement <procure@cloudwave.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:12:47 -0400
Subject: Re: GCP listing activation kickoff — seller activation litmus & procurement next steps

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear note and the litmus doc. I’ve looped in our procurement inbox (procure@cloudwave.com) — they’ll lead on PO/SOW. Quick answers: 
- Procurement contact is Tom Alvarez (tom.alvarez@cloudwave.com), he’s cc’d on this thread.
- We generally prefer a PO + SOW cadence rather than marketplace invoicing, but we can discuss direct billing if Redwood needs it for SKU reconciliation.
- SOC 2: we can share a redacted report under NDA; procurement will confirm if that’s sufficient.

We can do Tue 6/22 10:00am ET. I’ll accept a calendar invite. Please note procurement will want a draft SOW and SKU mapping before the call if possible so they can pre-route internally.

Best,
Sarah
Head of Cloud Programs, CloudWave Solutions
Phone: (555) 867-9012

Subject: Redwood SOW + SKU template for GCP listing (requested)

Hi Tom / procurement team —

Thanks for picking this up. Per Karthik and Sarah, please find attached the two documents we use to accelerate procurement review: 
- gcp_sku_mapping_template.csv (SKU names, entitlements, price tiers)
- redwood_standard_sow.docx (commercial + service definitions we propose for marketplace activations)

A few notes to speed review: 
1) SKU mapping: we populate recommended SKUs on the left; please confirm which billing model you prefer (GCP Marketplace direct billing vs. PO/invoice). If you prefer PO, we’ll need the billing contact and legal remit address.
2) SOW: the attached is our standard template; if you have procurement clauses or redlines, please flag them. We can accept redlines via DocuSign or share a counterparty-friendly addendum.
3) SOC 2: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II under an NDA. If procurement requests an on-site or additional artifact, let us know and we’ll escalate.

I’ve also created a short mutual action plan inside the Drive folder (link below) that outlines owner assignments and target dates — feel free to edit.

DocuSign: https://docusign.example.com/redwood/CW-SOW-2026 (placeholder — we’ll send the formal envelope once terms are agreed)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b-activation-materials

Attachments: gcp_sku_mapping_template.csv, redwood_standard_sow.docx

Thanks — I’ll be on the Tue 6/22 10:00am ET call.

— Olga Petrov
Lead, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — great alignment on the call. Quick recap and agreed next steps so procurement has a single source of truth: 

Mutual action plan (owners + ETA):
- CloudWave to confirm billing model and remit address (Tom) — due 2026-06-25
- CloudWave to confirm whether redacted SOC 2 is sufficient or if additional evidence is required (procure@cloudwave.com) — due 2026-06-24
- Redwood to send DocuSign SOW envelope (Olga) — expected 2026-06-23
- Redwood to provide fully populated SKU mapping (Karthik) — expected 2026-06-23
- Co-sell enablement: Redwood to request GCP partner co-sell introduction once SKUs are live (Vivek) — follow-up when listing is active
